newsitem.title: USA: APPLE OS 8 SYSTEM SALES UP SHARPLY.
newsitem.headline: APPLE OS 8 SYSTEM SALES UP SHARPLY.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc Friday said more than 1.2 million copies of its Mac OS 8 operating system have been sold since the product's retail introduction on July 26, quadrupling the company's expectations.
Mac OS 8 is the latest operating system software release for the Macintosh and Mac OS compatible systems -- and the most significant upgrade since 1984.
